GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

4. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.

5. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   C. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   D. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

7. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   B. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   D. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   C. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.

10. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   C. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.

11. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.
   C. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   B. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.

13. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

14. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   C. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   D. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   B. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   D. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Weathering and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Mass Wasting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Tourism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and Communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
